component.name: Appbox
component.summary: Web apps, each in its own session

description.p: Appbox keeps your web apps in one window, each in its own isolated session, with a sidebar to switch between them. Cookies, storage and logins never mix, so two accounts of the same service can live side by side.
It ships a GitHub tracker that lists the pull requests waiting on you and runs saved searches against the repositories you follow.
Distribution packages run Appbox on the system Electron, so the Chromium security updates come with the distribution. The Flatpak bundles the Electron release it was built with.
